positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the architecture, design, and implementation multiple databases/schemas (Postgres), web server APIs (Haskell, Rust, Node), web apps (Elm, React), and mobile apps (Rescript, React Native)
	•	Managed and set goals for a team of 3 developers, provided support and mentorship for each team member to grow and do the best work they could do
	•	Created and managed dev ops systems for both iOS and Android apps on their respective stores, along with various APIs and web apps
	•	Create highly scalable & reproducible build systems using Nix to allow the engineering team to move and deliver faster
	•	Wore many hats and collaborated cross departments (with product , sales, and operations teams) to align engineering milestones based on company direction, goals, and customer feedback
	•	Work closely with product and marketing teams to iterate and find product-market, as we learned real-time from customers and refined our customer offerings
	•	Worked with other department heads as we scaled to create a dynamic, flexible organization structure to maximize personal autonomy and accountability for all team members across the company
	•	Helped create an async communication culture that valued respect, critical thinking, and thoughtful discussion to improve the way that we talked and made decisions as an organization
positions.insights: Skills: OCaml · PostgreSQL · API Development · Project Management · Product Development · Front-End Development · Databases · Haskell · Team Management · Rust (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created and supported an admin portal to manage various types of users and data in React.
	•	Spearheaded the creation of iOS and Android mobile apps with React Native.
	•	Integrated various features such as Facebook Login, Google Maps, and Universal/Deep Linking into mobile and web apps.
	•	Created an efficient, sustainable system for reusing containers with Redux in React Native.
	•	Worked full-stack and cross-platform to create cohesive systems and optimize total project speed.

positions.description:

	•	 Spearheaded creation of iOS and Android mobile apps with React Native.
Integrated various features such as Facebook Login, Google Maps, and Universal/Deep Linking into mobile and web apps.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	 Created a rich domain model to handle complex user-management systems.
	•	 Designed a front-end tablet application to efficiently organize technical laboratory experiment data.
	•	 Created an offline-first front-end focused on a seamless user experience should network connections fail.
	•	 Created a mobile/tablet friendly data management platform to support structure and progress tracking in project management.
	•	 Wrote light and efficient SQL queries to quickly search and aggregate large amounts of data.
